facts.fact: Adam 把 Vic 送到 ghost kitchen，然后顺路去园艺中心买了要种在 Bobby 和 Annie 院子里的香草。
facts.anchor: Adam dropped Vic at the ghost kitchen and went by the garden center to get some herbs for Bobby and Annie’s yard.

facts.fact: Adam 这次没请 Silver 帮忙加固 Bobby 家的结界，因为开口求助可能把 Silver 的注意力引向 Ian。
facts.anchor: Asking for his help might draw his attention toward Ian.

facts.fact: Annie 说那两样东西听起来像报丧女妖（banshees）；Adam 回答它们算是一种，并有朋友已经证实。
facts.anchor: “They are, of a sort. A friend confirmed it.”

facts.fact: Annie 的父母仍在逃亡——主要因为 Annie 把手头的一切都交给了联邦探员（the feds），用来拆解 Patrick 的生意。
facts.anchor: They’d fled the country, largely thanks to Annie having given the feds everything she could to take Patrick’s businesses apart.

facts.fact: 在那次旅馆事件里，Adam 只是 White 手里的试验品，折磨他反而是额外的收获。
facts.anchor: Adam had been a test. The chance to torture him, a bonus.

facts.fact: Annie 同意给 Wilcox 打电话，但要让 FBI 在线上监听，看能否追踪这通电话。
facts.anchor: I’ll call him, but I’ll make sure the FBI is listening in.

facts.fact: Wilcox 之后来电告诉 Adam，书就放在 Erythraean，让他自己猜是哪个房间。
facts.anchor: You can find your book at the Erythraean. I’ll let you guess which room.

facts.fact: Vic 坚持要同行去取书——上次没能保护 Adam，这次他不肯让 Adam 独自回到那个地方。
facts.anchor: I’m not letting you go back there without me. I couldn’t protect you the last time. I’m not taking any chances now.
